changelog.title: Release notes
changelog.subtitle: Browsory · local-first multi-browser history archive and intelligence
changelog.feature1Description: Detects profiles from Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Arc, Firefox, and Zen. Browser databases are read through temporary copies and are not modified.
changelog.feature2Description: SQLite FTS5 searches titles and URLs with time, browser, domain, and favorite filters. Analytics include visit trends, hourly activity, and domain rankings.
changelog.feature3Description: The vault encrypts the local history database with SQLCipher and unlocks with a separate passphrase or recovery key. The optional PIN only locks the interface.
changelog.feature4Description: Configure a Windows scheduled task to incrementally sync enabled sources on a chosen interval. Turning the feature off removes its task.
changelog.feature5Description: Import Google Takeout JSON or external SQLite history, save offline pages, and export CSV, JSON, or Excel files. Exported files are not encrypted by the vault.
changelog.feature6Description: Configure a local or OpenAI-compatible AI service, or save WebDAV connection settings and test connectivity (two-way sync is not yet available). Data is sent to a configured service only when you enable and use that feature.
